records.name: Grover Cleveland-Mastery Charter School
records.notes: Public charter school in the Mastery Schools network at 5700 Wayne Ave, 19144. Families enroll through the school's application, so it is a school rather than a community group. Phone on the network site: 215-866-9000, extension x15001.

records.name: Here to Help Resource Center
records.summary: A help center for neighbors who need a hand with basic needs. It offers food, clothing, back-to-school supplies, help applying for grants and aid, job search support, and referrals to other services.
records.what_you_do: Ask for help with food, clothing, school supplies, aid applications, or job searching. The site also mentions daily workshops but gives no times.

first_step.how: Visit heretohelpresourcecenter.com and use the Contact page to ask what help is open to you.
first_step.basis: The site has Sign Up buttons that do not show a form, and no phone, email or address was shown, so the way in is unclear.

records.notes: Working site with no dated news or events, so probably_active rather than active. Copyright 2026 footer not counted. IRS filing address 5647 Heiskell St, 19144, is not shown on the site and is not published as a location. The guessed /get-involved page returned 404.

records.name: Hope for Tomorrow
records.summary: A Philadelphia nonprofit that gives out food, diapers, clothing, and water to families in need. It also runs a summer camp, a college scholarship, and holiday baskets and toys.
records.what_you_do: Ask about the food cupboard, diaper, clothing and water programs, or the summer camp and scholarship. The site does not say how to sign up, so call first.

first_step.how: Call (215) 844-8389 and ask how to sign up for the food cupboard, diaper, or summer camp programs.
first_step.basis: Programs are listed but the site does not say who qualifies or how to start, so the way in is unclear.

records.notes: Site footer reads 2020 and no dated news was found, so probably_active rests on it being a working site with no dates. Eligibility is not stated; confirm before relying on it. Founded 2014 per the site. Youth programs listed: summer camp, undergraduate scholarship, Christmas toys, and Family Care Program. Delaware Valley Diaper Bank is named as the diaper program partner; not checked.

records.name: Incarnation Institute for Sex and Faith
records.summary: Teaches people about sex from a faith point of view, through webinars, resource sheets, and training for certified sex and faith educators.
records.what_you_do: Sign up for a webinar or event from the Events page, or read the resource sheets and discussion guides. The site also lists volunteer opportunities and training, but gives no details on either.

first_step.how: Open the Events page on incarnationinstitute.org and use the sign up link on the next event.
first_step.basis: Events have a public sign up link and no application is shown.

records.notes: Newest dated item is a Spring 2026 event (no month written). Site shows no address and does not say its events are in Philadelphia. IRS filing address 124 W Mount Pleasant Ave, 19119, is not shown on the site, so no location is published. Faith tradition is not stated on the site, so faith is left blank. No sex education tag exists, so the closest families and tags were used. Donation links on the site were not recorded.

records.name: International Ballet Exchange
records.summary: A Philadelphia ballet group that teaches a free 30-week ballet course in neighborhood public schools and stages story ballets for school and community audiences.
records.what_you_do: Attend a performance: the group presents story ballets and student showcases. The 30-week course is for students at participating schools, so students join through their school.

cost.text: The 30-week course is free for students at participating schools. Performance prices are not shown on the site.

first_step.how: Email christina@internationalballet.org or call 215-849-7950 to ask about upcoming performances and whether your school has the 30-week course.
first_step.basis: The site lists an email and phone but does not say how to enroll or buy tickets, so the way in is unclear.

records.notes: Newest dated item is a Spring Showcase on 05.16.2025 (written MM.DD.YYYY on the page). Batch website internationalballet.com is parked, so the group's own site at internationalballet.org is used. The site prints ZIP 19133 for its address while the IRS filing and batch say 19144; 19144 is recorded, check before relying on it. Supporters listed on the site: Philadelphia Cultural Fund and PA Council of the Arts.

records.name: Israel Tree of Life Ministries
records.notes: No web address on file: the website field holds the group name, not a link. Not searched this run, because the two WebSearch calls went to Masterminds Chess Club and International Ballet Exchange, which had better odds of a public way in. IRS filing address: 6724 Blakemore St, 19119, not confirmed elsewhere. Retry in a later wave with one search.

records.name: Bhakti Recovery Group
records.summary: A 12-step recovery fellowship for people working on addiction and related struggles. It adds bhakti yoga, a devotional practice, to the steps, and the only membership requirement is a wish to recover.
records.what_you_do: Go to a recovery meeting that follows the 12 steps and includes bhakti yoga. The site also has pages on how the program works and on working the steps.

first_step.how: Use the Meetings link on bhaktirecoverygroup.com to find a meeting time and go to one.
first_step.basis: The site says the only requirement is wanting recovery and links to meetings, but no meeting times were readable in our fetch.

records.notes: The IRS filing for EIN 332291471 is under the name Jagai Madhai Foundation and lists this website. The site does not name that foundation, so the link is unconfirmed; verify before trusting. The Philadelphia link comes only from the IRS address (616 W Johnson St, 19144). Meeting places were not shown on the pages read. The header refers to Krishna consciousness, which the site does not state outright, so faith is left blank. Status probably_active: working site with no dated items (footer year not counted).

records.name: Kids of Kadiogne
records.notes: Works on health and education for children and families in Senegal and other parts of Sub-Saharan Africa. The site offers donations and an email list only and shows no Philadelphia programs. IRS filing lists 124 W Cliveden St, 19119; the address alone does not make it a Philadelphia service.

records.name: Let Me Breathe
records.summary: A Philadelphia nonprofit that works with area youth and police, gives a training scholarship called the Life Award, and supports seniors, people in prison, military families, and young children who have lost both parents.
records.what_you_do: Email the group to ask about its youth, senior and outreach work, or about the Life Award training scholarship. The site says donations can be made by email or PayPal.

first_step.how: Email letmebreatheinc@gmail.com and ask how to get involved or apply for the Life Award training scholarship.
first_step.basis: The site only says to email for more information, with no program schedule, sign up form or application steps shown.

records.notes: Working site with no dated news (years in image file paths not counted). Youth work is described only as working with police; mentoring is the closest tag and should be checked. Prison outreach and military family help are listed but have no matching tag. The site gives no address and the IRS address 6655 Chew Ave, 19119, is not confirmed, so no location is published.

records.name: MasterMinds Chess Club
records.summary: A chess club in Philadelphia, started in 2001, whose tournaments have drawn many of the region's strongest players.
records.notes: Only evidence found is a U.S. Chess article dated September 13, 2019, which names the club's coach and tournament director as running it at that time. No current website, schedule, location or contact was found in one search. The batch website field held the club name, not a link, so none is recorded. No first step is given until a contact is confirmed. Not to be confused with Master Minds Chess Coaching or the Philadelphia Masterminds US Chess League team.

records.name: McKinley Family Plan
records.notes: The site offers donations only (money and vehicle donations). It lists no volunteer roles, events or sign up path for families, so there is no public way in. Other issues: the donation agreement is an unfilled template, the copyright line is a placeholder, the name is spelled two ways, and the newest year on the site is 2018. Not verified as a current operation.

records.name: Menschwork
records.summary: A nonprofit for Jewish men of all ages. It runs online support groups, workshops, and Mussar study, plus a yearly retreat where men build friendship and meaning together.
records.what_you_do: Join an online MenschGroup for confidential peer support, or sign up for the yearly men's retreat in Falls Village, Connecticut.

schedule.text: Annual men's retreat October 16 to 18, 2026, in Falls Village, Connecticut. Online MenschGroups and workshops: meeting times not shown on the pages read.

cost.text: Retreat: a $250 deposit reserves a spot, full payment was due September 1, and first-time attendees get $50 off. Online group costs not shown.

first_step.how: Email info@menschwork.org to ask about joining an online MenschGroup, or register for the October retreat at register.menschwork.org.
first_step.basis: Groups and the retreat have a public sign up path, though the retreat asks for a deposit and a separate fellowship is for ages 18 to 35.

records.notes: Philadelphia link is thin. The IRS filing gives a PO Box in 19118, but the retreat is in Connecticut and the online groups are national. A reviewer may decide this is out_of_area. Registration was shown as open, but the September 1 full payment date had passed as of 2026-10-08. Newest dated item is the January 2026 BrotherKeeper issue. Mussar is filed under scripture_study as the closest tag.

records.name: Mid Atlantic Social Club
records.summary: A club for men and fathers that supports its own members, mentors young people, and runs community drives for food, back-to-school supplies, and coats.
records.what_you_do: Join the youth group as a mentor, help with community engagement, or come to the club's community days and fundraisers.

schedule.text: Community events: Mid Atlantic Day on August 1, 2026 (school supplies, food, clothes and services; location to be announced), and a fundraising gala in November 2026 in Germantown. Regular meeting times are not shown on the pages read.

cost.text: Membership is by form, and the club reaches out after you apply. Gala tickets are sold through the site; prices not shown.

first_step.how: Email josh@midatlanticsocialclub.com to join the youth group or volunteer, or fill in the membership form on midatlanticsocialclub.com.
first_step.basis: The youth group and volunteering invite people by email, and the membership form is open, though the club contacts you before you join.

records.notes: IRS legal name: Mid Atlantic Social Club for Father S Urban Youth Educational. The events page also lists a June 2026 mixer in Wilmington, DE, outside Philadelphia. Other contacts on the site: men's group Jimmie@, community engagement rob@ (all at midatlanticsocialclub.com). The site is still being set up in places (shop items marked coming soon), so some pages may be incomplete. Status active rests on 2026 dated events; the August event is past as of 2026-10-08.

records.name: Mount Airy Homeschooling Collective
records.summary: A co-op for homeschooling families in the Philadelphia area. Each family pays tuition for the term, and members take turns in volunteer roles such as assistant teacher and social event coordinator.
records.what_you_do: Members volunteer about 12 to 14 hours per term, in roles such as assistant teacher, closer or social event coordinator.

cost.text: Fall 2026 tuition is $430 per family, paid at the start of the term. Tuition is voted on each term.

first_step.how: Read the Member Handbook on mountairyhomeschoolcoop.org, email mtairyhomeschoolingcoop@gmail.com for a site visit or membership event, then submit the Apply now form. New members are taken in fall and spring when there is space.
first_step.basis: Members apply, pay tuition each term and volunteer, and a waitlist applies when the co-op is full.

records.notes: Membership co-op: applications, a waitlist when full, and background checks for volunteers who have lived in PA under 10 years. The site shows no phone or address. parent_playgroups is the closest tag for a co-op of homeschooling families. Status active rests on the Fall 2026 tuition line; no month is written, so no last_sign_of_life is recorded. The membership page was reached by guessing its path, and it loaded. The site lists the email as mtairyhomeschoolingcoop@gmail.com.

records.name: One Way One Love
records.notes: The site says its programs are coming soon (three entries marked TBA). The mission page was linked but not read. The site has a registration form, a sponsor form and an events page, but no dates, email, phone or address. The site name is One Way One Love CDC. The IRS batch lists 4945 Germantown Ave Apt 1, 19144, which is not confirmed on the site. Retry after programs are announced.

blocked.note: Redirects to a domain-for-sale parking page. Not followed; treated as a dead domain. The group's own site is internationalballet.org.

notes: Both WebSearch calls used. Masterminds Chess Club: only a September 2019 U.S. Chess article found, so status is dormant. International Ballet Exchange: group site found at internationalballet.org. Israel Tree of Life Ministries was not searched, because the budget went to the two groups with better odds of a public way in; it is held back as unknown and can be retried. Search results also surfaced chess community leads (two lichess team pages for Northeast Philadelphia and Community College of Philadelphia clubs, a Northeast Times article on free chess in Rittenhouse Square, and a Free Library chess calendar item). Not followed: they are platform, news or library pages rather than group sites, and no search budget was left to verify them. Guessed same-site paths /get-involved (Here to Help) and /meetings (Bhakti Recovery Group) returned 404. No bot checks, 403s or rate limiting were seen. Fetch budget left: about 37 of 60. Verdict counts: publish 12 (two of them, Israel Tree of Life Ministries and One Way One Love, are unknown and held back), hide 1, not_a_group 1, out_of_area 1.
